rules.rationale: Android 16 preserves the final A13 China-game validation policy for both nxt_cn and bst.country=CN configurations. The initial promotion returned false before reading the global captive-portal setting; follow-up 6d7e4d17 instead selects IGNORE as the regional default and then applies an explicit user or administrator override.
rules.necessity: Required to prevent China-region game update failures while retaining the platform control surface used for diagnostics and managed policy.
rules.performance: Two property reads and one settings lookup when validation policy is evaluated; there is no packet-path overhead.
rules.security: Ignoring validation can hide captive portals or interception. Restricting it to the regional default and preserving explicit setting precedence limits that exposure.
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng NetworkStack and NetworkStackTests built successfully after the correction.
Component commit 6d7e4d175654da4b8155da5916cf63d99c6cdf0c and root commit d3715b34bb4fbc8ab1e0860da13f422b2080caeb record the final policy. Runtime override regression remains in the final boot gate.
